content: वरण्डः [वृ-अण्डच् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 120</ls>] .²1 A multitude, group. .²2 A pimple or eruption on the face. .²3 A veranda. .²4 A heap of grass. .²5 The string of a fish-hook. .²6 Pocket. .²7 The middle part of the sacrificial altar (वेदी); see वरण्डक. (The word वरण्डलम्बुक in यदिदानीमहं वरण्डलम्बुक इव दूरमुत्क्षिप्य पातितः <ls>Mk. 1</ls> is of doubtful meaning; it seems to mean ‘an over-hanging or projecting wall’, which, if raised high, is sure to topple down; so in the case of the Sūtradhāra whose expectations were raised very high only to be cruelly disappointed. वरण्ड may mean a contrivance for drawing water from a well (named आकती in Marathi) and लम्बुक is its handle.)
